absent: Numeric values of taint flags and capability bits and error codes and memory type enumerators.
Complete layouts of module and load information and related loader structures beyond fields referenced here.
Forced-load policy and license classification mapping and retpoline and livepatch metadata checks.
Generic section layout and symbol table layout and per-CPU handling and kallsyms and exception table algorithms.
Executable-memory allocation and codetag section management and page protection primitives.
Module mutex hierarchy and notifier chain effects and object event effects and wait-queue protocol.
Tracing and jump label and static call and BTF and dynamic debug and error-injection integration details.
Boot wiring of the blacklist string and async probe request path and statistics accounting definitions.

findings.text: Version magic comparison is provided as a reusable loader helper that reports whether two magic strings are considered equal, with optional checksum token handling.
Strict permission management is exposed through helpers that validate section flags and mark post-init read-only sections and write-protect the post-init region.
Architecture specific section preprocessing and finalization are weak default services that succeed without action unless overridden by an architecture.
Deferred init reclamation synchronization and init address-tree detachment and duplicate load failure accounting are exposed as loader services for use across load phases.

Kernel taint augmentation derives module-scoped taints from embedded metadata: presence under key test maps to taint TAINT_TEST and absence under key intree maps to taint TAINT_OOT_MODULE and livepatch identity maps to taint TAINT_LIVEPATCH and presence under key staging maps to taint TAINT_CRAP and failed signature verification maps to taint TAINT_UNSIGNED_MODULE and license classification may map to taint TAINT_PROPRIETARY_MODULE, with one-time diagnostics, while fixed list module_license_offenders and name ndiswrapper force global proprietary taint.

Version validation honors ignore flag MODULE_INIT_IGNORE_VERMAGIC that treats magic as absent; absent magic delegates to a forced-load decision, mismatched magic fails loading with exec-format error ENOEXEC after reporting observed versus expected values, and livepatch metadata undergoes an additional independent check.
Magic equality skips leading checksum material up to the first blank in each input when checksums are present, otherwise it requires full string equality.

Section discovery populates module metadata for parameters via __param and exported symbols via __ksymtab with checksums via __kcrctab and flags via __kflagstab and exception handling via __ex_table plus enabled optional subsystems such as tracing and debugging and testing; obsolete export and parameter sections are ignored with a diagnostic, and simultaneous presence of both constructor styles ctors and init_array fails loading.

Final placement reserves each required memory class, relocates every section flagged SHF_ALLOC into its class region or into separately managed tag storage when required and skips copying for type SHT_NOBITS, validates the embedded module record size, publishes relocated addresses back for later phases, and on failure restores protections and releases all acquired regions and tag storage.

Exported symbol publication when count num_syms is non-zero requires accompanying table flagstab otherwise loading fails; when symbol versioning is enabled a missing table crcs is resolved through the forced-load decision rather than failing unconditionally.
Instruction cache coherence is established for every populated module memory region before parameter handling so that accessor functions provided by the module observe relocated code.
Module suppression uses a global comma separated name list; matching requires exact whole-entry equality and a null list disables suppression.

Generic placement validates architecture adjusted sections for strict permissions, excludes processor-local storage from generic allocation, applies post-init marking before sizing, performs generic layout and symbol table layout, copies sections to final memory, and returns the relocated module with leak tracking and tag replacement applied.

Section flag enforcement is inert when strict module permissions are disabled; when enabled any section marked both writable via SHF_WRITE and executable via SHF_EXECINSTR fails loading with identification of the offending section. Post-init marking tags sections whose names belong to a fixed internal set.

Module teardown releases processor-local storage and architecture init resources and tag storage and generic memory. Relocation completion orders exception table sorting and processor-local data copy and symbol table setup and architecture finalization, propagating the architecture step outcome.
Constructor invocation walks table ctors up to count num_ctors only when constructor support is enabled; without that support promotion performs no constructor calls.
A file-scope flag records whether asynchronous probing is enabled globally; successful promotion waits for all asynchronous work unless the individual module opted into asynchronous probing.

Deferred init reclamation uses a record containing a lock-free linkage held in node plus three opaque region pointers held in init_text for text and held in init_data for data and held in init_rodata for read-only data that are freed together after a grace period.

Init memory reclamation drains the global deferred list and waits for a read-copy-update grace period then releases each region through executable-memory release and frees its record; queueing new work occurs only when the list transitions from empty, and a dedicated flush service synchronizes with pending reclamation.

Post-init write protection for region MOD_RO_AFTER_INIT is a no-op unless strict permissions and read-only data support are both active. Region protection update is a no-op for empty regions and otherwise resets flush state and applies the supplied page protector over the region page span.
Successful promotion detaches all populated init regions from the module address lookup tree and then clears their base and size so later lookups no longer resolve init addresses.

Load permission requires privilege CAP_SYS_MODULE and that flag modules_disabled is clear otherwise error EPERM. Duplicate handling waits only for modules still forming, records failure accounting with a reason bit and reference count, then reports error EEXIST when the existing module reached live and error EBUSY otherwise.

Duplicate failure accounting aggregates by module name under list dup_failed_modules: an existing entry increments its counter and reason mask, otherwise a new zeroed entry is allocated and named and counted and published.

Load completion probing reports true when no module of the given name exists or when the existing module is already in state MODULE_STATE_LIVE or in state MODULE_STATE_GOING, evaluated under the global module mutex with sleep annotation.

Successful promotion frees init executable tracking and enables post-init protection with a diagnostic on failure and sanitizes non-allocated debug pointers and clears descriptors for regions MOD_INIT_TEXT and MOD_INIT_DATA and MOD_INIT_RODATA and accounts text size and total size and load count.

The global module mutex serializes completion probing and successful promotion teardown including init detachment and protection and duplicate-load decisions; duplicate handling releases the mutex while sleeping for a concurrently forming module and reacquires it afterwards; failure-list updates execute with the mutex held; init reclamation defers freeing until after a read-copy-update grace period; publication of core symbol data uses read-copy-update assignment.

Module lifecycle moves from waiting states MODULE_STATE_UNFORMED and MODULE_STATE_COMING to published state MODULE_STATE_LIVE on successful init and to teardown state MODULE_STATE_GOING on init failure; the live transition issues a state notifier and an object addition event, while the failure path marks going and synchronizes read-copy-update and issues a going notifier and releases livepatch and tracing state and frees the module and wakes waiters; concurrent loaders treat live and going and disappearance as terminal.

Late loading forms a pipeline where placement produces the relocated module and relocation completion prepares exception and processor-local and symbol metadata and promotion executes constructors and the init routine then either publishes the module as live or unwinds it.

An init routine returning error EEXIST is remapped to error EBUSY to preserve the distinct already-loaded signal for the load system call; positive init returns trigger a diagnostic but still count as success.

Successful promotion leaves init mappings with writable and executable permissions until deferred reclamation runs after a grace period; any code requiring cleaned mappings must synchronize through the provided flush service before enforcing read-only protections.

Name ndiswrapper applies a global proprietary taint without restricting its own access to restricted symbols, unlike normal module-scoped taints; obsolete export sections are ignored with a warning rather than failing, which can mask toolchain mismatch; simultaneous constructor styles ctors and init_array fail loading.
Module specific parameter names carry a fixed prefix formed by the word module followed by a period.
Well known section names for parameters and exported symbols and checksums and flags and exception tables constitute part of the module binary interface and drive metadata binding.
